_about: FMCG field playbook: each finding Cooper can detect maps to 2-3 concrete actions. Edit freely; the ids are used by backend/app/rca.py.

holiday.title: Fewer working days
actions: Compare per working day, not totals: the drop in totals is expected when a holiday falls in the period.
Plan make-up beats for the day before and after the holiday, so high-value outlets on the missed beat are not skipped.
Pre-load distributors and outlets with festive and fast-moving SKUs before the next holiday.

fewer_reps.title: Fewer reps in the market
actions: Check leave and absenteeism with ASMs and fill vacant territories, or assign a buddy rep to cover the open beats.
Ask managers to confirm day-start every morning, so 'day not started' and missing attendance are followed up the same day.
Plan leave around festivals in advance so no territory goes uncovered for several days.

leave_up.title: More reps on leave
actions: Review leave by territory; stagger festival leave so each beat still gets a visit.
Cover high-value outlets on open beats by telephonic orders or the distributor's salesman.

fewer_calls.title: Fewer calls per rep per day
actions: Fix the beat plan (PJP): drop closed and duplicate outlets and keep 30-40 outlets per beat so a rep can finish it.
Nudge reps to start the day on time and track first-call time daily; late starts are the fastest way to lose calls.
Use joint working by ASMs on the weakest beats to find what slows reps down (travel, waiting at outlets, stock issues).

low_pc_pct.title: Fewer visits turning into orders (PC %)
actions: Give each rep a must-sell SKU list per outlet type and track it, so every call has a clear order to pitch.
Communicate the live schemes and offers at every call; low conversion often means retailers don't know the schemes.
Check stock at the distributor: reps can't book what isn't available, so out-of-stocks show up as non-productive calls.

zero_pc.title: Reps with full days and no orders
actions: Call the reps who had zero-order days the same evening; check if they were on the right beat and if stock was available.
Pair these reps with a top performer or ASM for joint working this week.
Re-check their beats: outlets may be closed, wrongly mapped or served by another channel.

late_start.title: Late first calls
actions: Send a start-day nudge at 9:30 and share a daily list of reps whose first call was after 10:30.
Agree a market start time with ASMs and review it in the morning huddle.
Plan the first outlet of every beat close to the rep's starting point to cut travel time.

low_drop_size.title: Smaller orders per productive call
actions: Push upselling: suggest the next pack size up and bundle offers at each productive call.
Widen the range per outlet with assortment targets (lines per call) for each outlet class.
Focus high-value SKUs and schemes on the top outlets of each beat.

low_lpc.title: Fewer lines per call
actions: Set a lines-per-call target per outlet type and show reps a suggested order in the app.
Train reps to pitch focus and new SKUs after the regular order, not instead of it.
Check if lines are missing because of distributor stock-outs on those SKUs.

ubo_down.title: Fewer outlets billed (UBO)
actions: List outlets billed last period but not this one and get reps to visit them first.
Follow up with distributors on orders booked but not invoiced (stock or credit holds).
Run a reactivation scheme for outlets that stopped billing.

distributors_not_billing.title: Distributors billing less
actions: Call the distributors whose billing dropped most and check stock, credit limit and pending claims.
Clear pending claims and scheme settlements quickly; distributors hold back orders when money is stuck.
Share a suggested order based on their secondary sales and stock norms (days of stock).

low_invoice_value.title: Smaller primary invoices
actions: Check if distributors are ordering fewer SKUs or smaller quantities; share stock-norm based suggested orders.
Use month-end and quarter-end schemes to bring forward primary orders.
Review credit limits for distributors who are cutting order size.

low_coverage.title: Fewer planned outlets visited (coverage)
actions: Track PJP adherence daily: reps should visit every outlet on the planned beat.
Clean the beat plans so the planned outlets are real, open and reachable in a day.
Review reps who skip beats or change beats often with their ASM.

tour_plan.title: Tour plan not followed
actions: Lock the monthly tour plan and get ASM approval for any beat change.
Share a daily report of reps who worked a different beat than planned.

region_drop.title: Decline concentrated in a few areas
actions: Start with the areas listed below: hold a review with those ASMs/RSMs this week.
Check for local causes there first: a distributor issue, a vacant territory, a competitor scheme or local holidays.

season.title: Seasonal pattern
actions: Compare with the same period last year to separate the seasonal effect from real performance.
Plan schemes and stock ahead of the season instead of reacting after it.

sustain.title: Keep the momentum
actions: Share what worked in the top areas and reps with the rest of the team in the next review.
Lock in the gain: keep the beat plans, schemes and stock levels that drove the increase.
Check that the increase is real demand and not a one-off (scheme loading or a holiday catch-up).
